title: Bridgerton Season 4 Premiere to Air Early at Fan Event
text:
Fans of the hit Netflix series Bridgerton will get to watch the Season 4 premiere two weeks early at a special live event on January 14, 2026. The event will include a live virtual screening of the first episode, red carpet interviews, and a special performance. Season 4 focuses on Benedict Bridgerton's search for Sophie Baek. The season will officially release on January 29th.
There is little worse than having to wait for a new season of your favorite television series, especially in the streaming age. While streaming platforms and their original entertainment has given tv fans a rich entertainment landscape of shows to choose from and get hooked on, sometimes the production cycles are lengthy, meaning it can be years between seasons, causing fan anticipation to grow higher and higher.
That’s certainly the case for Netflix’s massive hit,. The series ended its third season in June 2024, and fans have been eagerly awaiting the next chapter. Now, even with the beloved series set to return in January, you’ll be able to watch the Season 4 premiere two weeks early.Season 4 Premiere Masquerade event. The fan event will take place live on Tudum on January 14, 2026, beginning at 11:30 am CT, but it’s no ordinary live event. The event will include preshow festivities, red carpet interviews, a special performance and, of course, the Season 4 premiere featuring a live virtual screening of the first episode.will arrive properly on Netflix on January 29th with the second half to follow in February. As for how to attend what is sure to be the biggest event of the season, all fans need to do RSVP by 9:30 pm. PT on January 13th atBridgerton , Season 4 will focus on a new romance, this time following the free-spirited Benedict Bridgerton searching for the masked and mysterious lady he was charmed by at a masquerade ball — Sophie Baek . The problem? Sophie is the illegitimate child of an Earl and is of a lower social status, having been treated as lesser and in servitude to her stepmother, Lady Araminta Gun . The season is based on author Julia Quinn’s third novel in theenticing, the new season will also see the return of some beloved familiar faces. Ruth Gemmell is set to return as matriarch Lady Violet Bridgerton along with Hannah Dodd and Florence Hunt as daughters Francesca and Hyacinth.
